posts.name: Empacer
posts.tagline: The voice-first assistant for small business owners
posts.description: Most small business owners face the same problem when trying to use AI tools: they don't have time for re-explaining their business in every chat. Empacer is designed to skip this part. Three questions at setup, then spoken requests become a ready plan and finished work: customer replies, social posts, invoices and more. Nothing is sent without the owner's approval.

posts.name: Scape
posts.tagline: An intelligent email inbox that works for you
posts.description: Imagine opening your inbox and finding everything already organized, with replies ready to review. Scape is an intelligent email client that prioritizes messages, prepares contextual drafts, and helps track conversations and follow-ups. It understands your work across emails, meetings, calendars, and attachments, so you can spend less time managing communication and more time moving work forward.

posts.name: Floot in ChatGPT
posts.tagline: Build and publish real apps without leaving ChatGPT
posts.description: Floot is now a native app in your ChatGPT sidebar. Describe what you want, watch it build in a live preview inside the chat, and publish it with a real link. Database, logins and hosting are built in, and the AI runs on your ChatGPT plan.

posts.name: Notch Metrics
posts.tagline: Use claude code to build analytics widgets for your notch
posts.description: Revenue, MRR and subscribers from Stripe, Polar, Paddle, Dodo Payments and more, in the MacBook notch.

posts.name: Gologin Cloud Browser
posts.tagline: Cloud browser for AI agents and tough sites
posts.description: Gologin Cloud Browser gives AI agents and scrapers real Chromium browsers that stay logged in. Persistent sessions survive across runs, so there’s no re-auth or lost state. Built-in stealth and anti-bot protection, plus proxies in 150+ countries. Fully serverless, it scales to thousands of browsers and works with Playwright and Puppeteer via WebSocket. Built by the GoLogin team: 7 years’ expertise, SOC 2 Type II, 99.9% SLA. Plans from $4.50/mo.

posts.name: Gemini 4 Carbon
posts.tagline: Google's next frontier model
posts.description: Gemini 4 Carbon is our strongest model with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long horizon capabilities.

posts.name: TopAgent
posts.tagline: Drive B2B event attendance with an AI agent
posts.description: Fill your next B2B conference, summit, or workshop with SMS invitations and relevant follow-ups. Give TopAgent your opted-in audience, event details, registration link, and deadline. It prepares the campaign, monitors delivery, clicks, and replies, and returns with follow-ups ready for your approval.

posts.name: Radar
posts.tagline: You don't need an AI SRE. Give your agent Radar.
posts.description: Your agent knows Kubernetes. It doesn't know your cluster. Radar (open-source) gives it context over MCP: ranked issues, a change timeline, logs and owners in one view. New: click Investigate on a failing workload. Claude Code, Codex or Cursor finds the root cause, read-only, with evidence for each claim. In our benchmark of 50 live faults across six tools, Radar found the most root causes. Radar Cloud investigates every alert and posts findings to Slack.

posts.name: IFTTT.ai
posts.tagline: The easiest way to automate anything
posts.description: IFTTT is now IFTTT.ai, and every plan now includes our core features and all 1,000+ services, from multiple actions and filters to queries and Webhooks. Pricing is credit-based, and you can build unlimited Applets for free. AI got an upgrade too. AI Agent watches web pages for price changes or new listings, AI Action assist writes each action based on its trigger, and AI queries run on better models. Or describe an automation in IFTTT Chat and it builds the Applet for you.

posts.name: Confetti
posts.tagline: Easiest way to build hardware gadgets using plain English
posts.description: Making hardware used to take weeks of learning CAD, sourcing compatible parts, and writing firmware. With Confetti, it starts with a conversation. Create and edit designs, find components, and order printed parts straight to your doorstep. Start from scratch or remix a community project to make it your own.

posts.name: Viggle JST-2
posts.tagline: JST-2: 3D scenes, characters and motion from one model
posts.description: JST-2 is Viggle’s physics-native world foundation model for generating 3D scenes, characters and full-body motion in one shared world. Scenes take about one second, characters come from one image or text with motion built in, and motion comes from text or video. Try it free in the PINOC browser app, or use the API or MCP with agents like Claude Code. Benchmarks are Viggle’s own blind human tests.

posts.name: Intrascope 2.0
posts.tagline: New AI agent, 1,650+ apps, Skills and smart model routing
posts.description: What's different: ChatGPT and Claude lock you into one vendor. Intrascope 2.0 gives your team 120+ models (GPT-6, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Qwen) plus an AI agent that works in 1,650+ apps like Gmail, Slack, Drive and Notion. The company stays in control: admins approve apps and models, set budgets per team, project and person, and see every token and dollar. New in 2.0: agent, connectors, Skills, Auto routing, full redesign. Private and on-prem deployments for enterprise.

posts.name: JIMMY
posts.tagline: JIMMY is an AI agent that runs on your PC
posts.description: JIMMY runs on your Windows PC and listens to your WhatsApp self-chat. Text "send the resume in Downloads to Rahul" or "screenshot" and it does the task, asks before sending anything, and replies. Scheduled tasks, custom commands, /stop and an undo log included.

posts.name: Voxel51 Multimodal
posts.tagline: Better data. Smarter robots. Repeat.
posts.description: The real world is messy. Robots encounter unexpected situations and behave in ways you never anticipated. But every failure is a chance to teach your robot something new. The hard part? Sifting through hours of video and sensor data to figure out why your robot failed. Voxel51 is an end-to-end multimodal data platform that accelerates robot learning. Find the failures that matter, understand why they happened, and fill gaps in your training data to improve models faster. Try Voxel51 for free.

posts.name: Suno MCP
posts.tagline: The music layerfor your AI stack
posts.description: MCP stands for Model Context Protocol, an open standard that lets AI assistants work with other apps. The Suno MCP connects your Suno account to the AI assistants you already use, like ChatGPT and Claude. Once it’s connected, you can ask your assistant to make a song, extend it, cover it, and more, right in the conversation you’re already having! Your assistant can use everything you’ve already discussed (lyrics, a project, a video plan) so you don’t have to re-explain your idea.

posts.name: Smart Jelly
posts.tagline: Your everyday AI tools and memory in one Mac app.
posts.description: One app for dictation, live meeting help, Pre meeting notes, Notetaker, Track open loops and agents, all sharing one memory of you. No need to pay for five AI tools that each start from zero. Every feature knows your work and gets smarter as you use it.

posts.name: AutoShelf 2.6
posts.tagline: Automate any folder on your Mac with if-this-then-that rules
posts.description: AutoShelf is a Mac app that automatically files, renames, tags, converts, and sorts new files in folders like Downloads and Desktop, based on rules you set once. New: sort into subfolders built from tokens like %kind% and %date%, unarchive, Finder color labels, and rules that cover all or selected subfolders. Free with 1 rule, or $19.99 one-time for unlimited rules ($29.99 from Nov 25). Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later.

posts.name: StoreLocale
posts.tagline: Translate app UI in App Store & Google Play screenshots
posts.description: Localize the UI inside App Store and Google Play screenshots. StoreLocale detects text, translates it into 32 languages, and repaints it in place while keeping the layout intact. Review results in the editor, then export PNGs grouped by store, language, and size. The editor is free; use your own Gemini or OpenRouter API key, or buy one-time credits for AI image generation.

posts.name: ChatInbox
posts.tagline: Email that groups your inbox by contact
posts.description: ChatInbox rebuilds the inbox around people instead of time. Every customer, vendor or friend becomes one conversation: full history, every file, whose turn it is. That is CRM-grade context inside your mailbox, across Gmail, Outlook, iCloud and any IMAP account, with newsletters and receipts filed into Feeds automatically. Three years of iteration, native on Mac, iPhone and iPad. Apple Intelligence powers drafting, summaries and triage on-device, so your mail never leaves your devices.

posts.name: Kin
posts.tagline: The AI labs want to own you. Make them answer to you.
posts.description: Let your AIs run free. Kin keeps them in check. Connect GitHub, Gmail or Stripe once, add Kin to ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor, and give each action a rule: Allow, Ask me or Block. Ask me waits for your OK on the web or your phone.

posts.name: MAO
posts.tagline: Team up Claude Code, Codex and Grok on one canvas
posts.description: Put Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and Grok on one canvas and let them work as a team. Wire two agents and they talk, delegate and hand back results while you lead. Native on macOS, Linux and Windows, built in Rust. 7-day free trial, no card. Then $20, once.

posts.name: Reset Alerts
posts.tagline: Codex Reset Alerts via Text (Use it Before You Lose It)
posts.description: Get a free text when OpenAI announces a Codex usage limit reset, and another when it's available. Use what's left before your limits reset. Text START to sign up: no app to install. SMS in the US + Canada, Telegram worldwide.

posts.name: AfterLid
posts.tagline: Keep your Mac working. Check in from your phone.
posts.description: Keep builds, downloads and local AI tasks running on your Mac, then check its status from your iPhone or Android. Free includes Mac power controls and live phone status. Pro adds remote mode switching. Battery, thermal and session limits stay in place.

posts.name: Polylane for ChatGPT
posts.tagline: Ask ChatGPT what broke in production
posts.description: Polylane brings your production context into ChatGPT. Ask what changed, read logs and metrics, trace dependencies, and investigate issues using your code and infrastructure. Explore service maps, blast radius graphs and issue cards right in the chat, with evidence linked back to Polylane. Install the plugin, sign in, and ask.

posts.name: Enclave
posts.tagline: One hover, everything you need.
posts.description: Enclave turns your MacBook's notch into a live dashboard. Hover it to see Now Playing, your next meeting, to-dos, a focus timer, a file shelf and clipboard history. Closed, it shows music, downloads, AirDrop, volume and battery. For developers, it tracks Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and more: approvals, questions, test results and deploys, right in the notch. Native SwiftUI, private and on-device.

posts.name: OutreachGuy
posts.tagline: The AI SDR that works the leads you never followed up
posts.description: Most leads never get a second message. OutreachGuy is an AI SDR that picks up the list you never finished: old enquiries, demos that went quiet, trials that never paid. He researches each person, writes from your own inbox and accounts, and follows up on email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Telegram, phone, X, Instagram and Reddit. A reply changes the plan. When someone is ready to talk, he checks your calendar and asks you before he books.

posts.name: Flatbread
posts.tagline: Share the whole agent run, not a screenshot
posts.description: Flatbread turns a coding agent's session into one link: what was asked, every step, what broke, what fixed it and the diff. Redaction runs on your machine before anything uploads. Another agent can pull the link and pick up where it ended.

posts.name: Arco
posts.tagline: GitHub and Linear issues, right inside your Codex
posts.description: Arco is a free, open-source Codex plugin for managing GitHub and Linear issues. You can - View issues in chat, in a side panel, or full screen. - Create, close, and reopen issues. - Add comments. - Select passages from issues and add them to your next Codex prompt. Arco runs locally on your machine. No server hosting required🎻

posts.name: AssemblyAI
posts.tagline: text-to-speech built for voice agents
posts.description: AssemblyAI-TTS-1: natural speech for voice agents, streaming in 90 ms. Unlimited concurrency, no annual contract, $15 per 1M characters.

posts.name: Recall for Mac
posts.tagline: Remember everything that happens on your Mac
posts.description: Download Recall for macOS. Real-time call live transcription without bots, smart clipboard manager, live music & video activities with lyrics, temp shelf, live atmospheric weather, and floating desktop widgets for Mac. Apple Silicon and Intel.

posts.name: Draxlr Embedded Analytics
posts.tagline: Self-serve analytics in your SaaS, with row-level security
posts.description: Embed a complete analytics workspace inside your SaaS. Your customers explore data with AI, a visual query builder or raw SQL, and create their own dashboards inside embed. Row-level security keeps each customer to their own rows.

posts.name: Free and private AI Notetaker
posts.tagline: Stop paying for Granola
posts.description: Bookipi AI Notetaker is a free meeting notetaker that runs natively on your Mac. No account needed: download the AI models once and start recording right away. Transcription and summaries happen locally, with no bots joining your calls, no subscription and no data uploaded. Ask AI about past meetings, dictate into any app, organize notes by people and folders, import your notes from Granola, and connect your own AI model if you prefer. Requires macOS 26 on Apple Silicon.

posts.name: Indexly
posts.tagline: AI Search Growth Platfrom
posts.description: Get recommended by AI and grow organic traffic without the grind. Indexly tracks where you're missing, then runs distribution and optimization on autopilot, from content to social to Reddit to ads, and proves the traffic and leads.

posts.name: ActionMind
posts.tagline: Turn meetings in any language into tasks you approve
posts.description: Your AI teammate for meeting follow-ups. ActionMind joins your Google Meet, Zoom or Teams calls and catches every task, owner and deadline in 90+ languages, even when people switch languages mid-sentence. It drafts the email, calendar event or Jira issue for you, and sends it to Gmail, Calendar, Jira, Notion or Slack only after you approve. Then it checks back and tells you which tasks are done, still open or running late. No more "who was supposed to do that?"

posts.name: Sam Health
posts.tagline: All-in-one chronic condition app, now on your Apple Watch
posts.description: Sam Health is one place for life with a chronic condition, instead of several apps and a paper diary. Dedicated programs for 8 conditions, including high blood pressure, migraine, asthma and hay fever, plus a diary, medication reminders and reports for 20+ more. Sam reads what your Apple Watch already records, shows what changed against your own normal, and turns the months since your last visit into a report for your doctor. New: Sam's own Apple Watch app.

posts.name: Lumirank.ai
posts.tagline: Get recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and all other AI
posts.description: Lumirank helps your brand get recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and other AI agents. It measures how often AI answers mention you, and what they say about you and your competitors. Then it gives you clear actions to rank higher, such as content to create or improve. You can now track and improve your ranking on every source the AI cites: websites, articles, Reddit threads and YouTube videos.

posts.name: RakeSign
posts.tagline: Free, unlimited DocuSign alternative, for humans and agents
posts.description: RakeSign is a free, unlimited alternative to DocuSign. Prepare agreements, add signers and approval steps, reuse templates, and track every request through to the signed PDF. Use the app with your team, build signing into your product with the API, or give your agents signing powers with our MCPs and CLI.

posts.name: Steady Fasting
posts.tagline: The fasting app for the hour you usually quit
posts.description: A fasting app that doesn't make you track 40 things. No steps, water, calories, food photos or streaks. Steady checks in before your hardest hour and walks you through it: 3 minutes of paced breathing with haptics, or a quick puzzle.

posts.name: Prept
posts.tagline: The interview debrief no recruiter will send you
posts.description: Recruiters send the same template rejection to everyone, and it says nothing about how you did. Prept analyzes your actual interview, with everyone's consent, and gives you the honest debrief: what worked, where you lost the room, and what to say next time. It also turns your resume into facts you confirm and writes a resume matched to each job posting from those facts alone. Your audio is never used to train AI, sold or shared.

posts.name: HypAware
posts.tagline: The improvement loop for all your agents
posts.description: HypAware collects every Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Pi, OpenClaw, and Hermes session and shows what's broken, the evidence, the fix, and whether it stayed fixed. Free open source CLI; HypAware Cloud for the whole team.

posts.name: AlphaWeb.AI
posts.tagline: Supercharge How Your Team Sells With AI
posts.description: Your whole team, each with their own AI, working in one workspace with shared memory and data. Tell Claude, ChatGPT or any agent what you want and AlphaWeb hosts it: live pages, stores, funnels, apps and adaptive checkouts, subscriptions, upsells, payments built in, A/B testing 24/7 and so much more... Already on Shopify? Two-way sync, no migration.

posts.name: Saytraq
posts.tagline: Short daily AI lessons on your own work tasks
posts.description: Saytraq helps office workers make better use of the AI tools they already have in their everyday work. Start with a free assessment: tell us which tools you use, what you know about AI, and complete short tasks using your preferred AI tool. You’ll discover your current skill level and. identify areas for improvement! Based on your results, Saytraq creates a personalized learning plan with 20-minute lessons, 3 to 6 days a week, built around your actual work tasks.

posts.name: AvatarLab
posts.tagline: 3D Avatar Studio
posts.description: Studio-grade 3D avatars that move — for social, stories, games, apps, AI agents and whatever you dream up next.

posts.name: ThinkingOrbs
posts.tagline: Dotted, genuinely 3D loading indicators for AI in SwiftUI
posts.description: ThinkingOrb(.searching). That is the whole integration. Nine hand-tuned dotted loading indicators for AI and agent interfaces in SwiftUI: eight are real 3D forms, rotated, depth-shaded and z-sorted, and the ninth is a morphing outline. All drawn only in grayscale dots, so they sit quietly in any interface, light or dark. Every orb pauses itself offscreen, stays in phase with the others, and respects Reduce Motion. Swift 6, iOS 17+, macOS, tvOS, watchOS, and visionOS, Swift Package Manager, MIT.

posts.name: Worklicant
posts.tagline: Post a job. Accept applicants. Pay Per Vacancy. AI enabled.
posts.description: Worklicant is hiring software for tech teams. Pay per vacancy, no subscription. Built-in scheduling, analytics, preliminary testing. AI prioritization based on prompt. Good UI / UX.

posts.name: Product Bench & GTM Engines
posts.tagline: AI workflows for product, content, community, and outbound
posts.description: Give Claude Code and Codex a product brain. Turn your team’s knowledge into sharper research, stronger strategy, better specs, and faster execution.

posts.name: Breatic
posts.tagline: The real-time collaborative AI workspace for creative teams
posts.description: Your writer changed the story. Your designer is still working from the old brief. Breatic brings documents, canvases, comments, and AI-assisted creation into one real-time workspace, so creative teams can work through revisions together.

posts.name: AI Listers
posts.tagline: Amazon Seller Operating System & AI Seller Software
posts.description: Run listings, research, products, orders, inventory, profit, ads, pricing and account operations in one AI-assisted Amazon seller workspace. Start free.

posts.name: Krafters
posts.tagline: Ready-made AI specialists for ads, SEO/GEO and short videos
posts.description: Krafters is a club of specialized AIs for freelancers and small businesses who are new to AI. Plug it into Claude or ChatGPT with one connector, then launch a mission: an AI Ads that builds your Facebook and Instagram campaign, an AI SEO/GEO that audits your site and checks if ChatGPT cites you, and an AI Videos that writes and plans your Shorts. Built by a French solo founder after 300+ customers.

posts.name: Mochine
posts.tagline: Unboring Your Boring Videos
posts.description: Unboring your boring talking-head video. Record your video, and pick a Motion Kit. Mochine edits, animates, and makes it look great!

posts.name: Ainna AI
posts.tagline: AI for brainstorming and evaluating product ideas
posts.description: AI makes building anything easy. The expensive mistake now is building the wrong thing. Ainna brainstorms and frames ideas with you; the Judge, its independent AI assessor, grades each one on ten dimensions across problem and solution, naming the one holding it back. IN: a problem or a rough idea. OUT: graded opportunities with their market, competition and personas, plus pitch decks, PRDs and one-pagers. OUTCOME: a defensible yes or no, in hours, not quarters. https://ainna.ai/founders

posts.name: DiraX
posts.tagline: The AI journal you'll actually stick with
posts.description: Journaling only helps if you keep it up, and most people quit. DiraX makes it stick. After every entry, In house or self created AI companions with different personalities leave a thoughtful, personal reply, and a comment that lands can open into a chat. Each entry gets a psychological analysis, and a dashboard shows your overall state, real goal progress, and what to do next. You also get small mood-based recommendations: books, relaxing toys, little mood-lifters. Private and encrypted.

posts.name: oleander
posts.tagline: Multi-Engine Data Ecosystem for Agents & Builders
posts.description: oleander is a serverless, multi-engine data warehouse for agents and builders. Most queries don't need a cluster. Run SQL with DuckDB, DataFrames with Polars and distributed workloads with Spark or Bloom (Apache DataFusion). Intelligent routing picks the right engine and capacity to optimize cost and performance. Query your own open data or use oleander-managed Iceberg. Give agents secure and scoped MCP access and trace execution with OpenLineage.

posts.name: IndieCRM
posts.tagline: Simple sales CRM for indie builders and small teams
posts.description: Keep deals, contacts, companies and meetings together across your products. Manage a visual sales pipeline, connect Gmail and Google Calendar, and work with your CRM from ChatGPT, Codex, Claude or the CLI using your workspace permissions. $9/month with a 7-day free trial.

posts.name: Beyonder
posts.tagline: Build a software system for your business or yourself
posts.description: Beyonder is the AI living software factory. Start with ready-to-use, tested AI apps, from CRMs to content tools, or build your own by describing what you need. Beyonder draws on 150+ real business deployments to assemble your software from proven building blocks, not from scratch. Connect your data and workflows, make changes through conversation, and let Beyonder handle hosting and infrastructure. No coding required.

posts.name: Music Block Studio
posts.tagline: Integrated music notation editor
posts.description: Notation software is precise but slow to edit, and chatbots cannot read a score. Music Block Studio puts both in one place: a real notation editor with an AI agent that has the full context of the score. Ask for a reharmonization, an arrangement or a tab, and the AI proposes changes you review, accept or undo, like code diffs. Import scans, play back and export PDF, MIDI, MusicXML or MP3. Also free in ChatGPT: the Music Block app renders, plays and exports sheet music in the chat.

posts.name: orbench
posts.tagline: benchmark LLMs on your own tasks before you switch model
posts.description: You can pick a model on a gut feeling, orbenchmark it. orbench is a desktop app that lets you benchmark LLMs on your own tasks, A public leaderboard ranks models on someone else's prompts. Production evals give you more insights, but only after you've done all the work to implement the new models. orbench is the step in between: bring your real tasks (csv or HF dataset), pick any models on OpenRouter, and your own rubric grade every answer with an AI judge, a blind human review, or both.

posts.name: PM Events by AllthingsPM
posts.tagline: Product management and AI events, online and in your city
posts.description: A free, weekly-updated directory of product management and AI product events: meetups, talks, workshops and mixers from Luma and Meetup. Filter by city, online or in person, topic, date and price, and register in one click. Ended events drop off automatically every Monday.

posts.name: Modo
posts.tagline: Modo is a fast, quiet desktop app for reading, reviewing,
posts.description: A fast, quiet desktop app for reading, reviewing, and editing agent-written code.

posts.name: Rush QTE
posts.tagline: A 2-second quiz that does everything to make you fail
posts.description: Rush QTE is a reflex quiz: 2 seconds per question while the game throws fake texts, fake calls, memes and a cracking screen at you. Climb the Story mode (8 chapters, bosses to knock out with your thumb), beat the daily challenge, send a duel link to a friend or jump into the live arena that starts every minute. Movies, sports, flags, math, languages: 19 modes. Free on iPhone and in your browser, no signup.

posts.name: Shoot Yeah!
posts.tagline: Shoot Yeah! - A nostalgic arcade carnival shooter
posts.description: Remember classic arcade carnival games? Shoot Yeah! brings that experience to the web. What it is: Shoot targets across 3 lanes Progress through increasingly difficult levels Compete globally on leaderboards Mobile-friendly, no ads, completely free Nostalgic pixel-art arcade aesthetic Why I built it: I wanted to recapture that childhood feeling of arcade games. Built this in React in a few weeks. Try it: sy.lavigames.com

posts.name: Narro
posts.tagline: A free, open-source AI reader for your browser
posts.description: Narro is a free, open-source Chrome extension that reads web pages and Kindle books aloud with natural AI voices. Listen with private, offline voices running in your browser, or bring your own OpenAI, ElevenLabs, or Gemini API key. No subscription or signup required.

posts.name: TermTrax
posts.tagline: AI review of vendor terms against your own playbook
posts.description: TermTrax reviews a software vendor's terms for in-house counsel. Paste the vendor's URL: it finds every binding document, including those incorporated by reference, and scopes the set to how your organization will use the product. Each document is then reviewed against your own playbook. Only real issues are flagged, and every finding cites the exact clause with the source one click away, so checking takes seconds. No setup: start with the included playbooks or load your own. Free trial.

posts.name: signoff-ui
posts.tagline: Review what your agent changed, approve what it may do
posts.description: signoff-ui is React components for the step where a person signs off on what an agent does. DiffReview gives the agent back each file with only the accepted hunks applied, the rejected hunks and the reviewer's comments. ApprovalCard shows exactly what will run and lets you approve once, for the session or always. For AI SDK 6 and 7, AG-UI and ACP agents, inside assistant-ui, AI Elements or your own chat. MIT licensed.

posts.name: Shortener.dev
posts.tagline: Dub is going private. So I built an open-source alternative
posts.description: URL shortener with branded links, click analytics, device and geo targeting, and an API.

posts.name: Drugwars Online
posts.tagline: the legendary 1984 drug trading simulation, reborn
posts.description: Drugwars Online — the legendary 1984 drug trading simulation, reborn. Buy low, sell high across 10 global cities. Free to play, no account required.

posts.name: Cobuild
posts.tagline: The place to discover hacks and mods for the devices you own
posts.description: You paid for the device, but the company still controls it: ads on your TV, a monthly fee for your wearable, a speaker that's always listening, a paywall on your doorbell. Open-source builders have fixed most of it, but the fixes are buried across GitHub, Reddit and X. co.build puts 2,900+ mods for nearly 3,000 devices in one place. Every mod shows what it does, who built it and whether it worked on your exact model. Paste a setup prompt into Claude or ChatGPT, or request what gets built next.

posts.name: estaie
posts.tagline: Extended Stays & Furnished Monthly Homes
posts.description: Explore furnished homes and extended stays. Find your next monthly stay with estaie.

posts.name: PreSend
posts.tagline: AI Quotation & Document Checker
posts.description: PreSend helps freelancers, agencies and businesses check quotations, proposals and client-facing documents for pricing errors, missing information and inconsistencies before sending.

posts.name: Colaunched
posts.tagline: Business ideas from dated public demand, scored for you
posts.description: Colaunched turns what people already asked for in public into browsable business ideas with dates you can check. Free to browse. No card. Pro is only if you start one. We never estimate what you'll earn.

posts.name: P7MGratis
posts.tagline: Free P7M reader with local processing in your browser
posts.description: Open P7M signed files, view PDFs and Italian XML invoices, and extract originals for free. Processing stays in your browser; no account or document upload. Italian interface. Integrity checks are separate from legal signature validation.

posts.name: Astitva
posts.tagline: AI native creative studio for brand identity and pitch decks
posts.description: Build your brand and pitch deck in one AI-native flow

posts.name: Lecy
posts.tagline: The simplest loyalty solution
posts.description: Bring regulars back without asking them to download anything. Lecy is a dynamic NFC tag at the till: customers hold their phone to it while paying and the visit counts. No app, no card, no typing, no POS integration, nothing for staff to do. Each tap creates a unique encrypted link, so a point needs a real visit. Mixed feedback goes privately to the manager, happy customers are invited to review on Google. For cafés, restaurants, shops and franchise networks. From €35 a month per location.

posts.name: Gootaku
posts.tagline: Turn a prompt into manga, comic, GIF and anime clip panels
posts.description: Type a scene and Gootaku draws it as a manga, comic, GIF or short anime video panel. Try one panel without signing up. Add speech balloons, reuse your own characters, share to the community. One-time token packs, no subscription. 9 languages and an iOS app.

posts.name: Bad Alibi
posts.tagline: Party games made from your group chat
posts.description: Bad Alibi makes party games out of the people playing them. Your inside jokes, worst excuses and the friend who's always late become the plot. Our first game, The Missing Weekend Fund, is a mystery night for 3 to 10 friends, together or apart.

posts.name: Waffle Iron: Podcast Maker
posts.tagline: Make a podcast without the tutorials.
posts.description: A podcast recorder and editor for iPhone and iPad. Just press record and talk. After each take it evens out the levels, makes voices clearer and shortens the long pauses.
